summary: A Dubai headquartered law firm with offices in Abu Dhabi, Egypt and London appears to lose enquiries to mixed language menu labels and stray page code.

findings.problem: Russian menu labels appear in the English navigation on the same line as the English ones.
findings.cost: A mixed menu confuses visitors and looks like a template error.

findings.problem: Stray markup characters appear to show in the page text near the menu.
findings.cost: Broken code looks careless on a firm that sells precision.

findings.problem: The leading firm claim appears to repeat in several headings with no rankings or reviews shown.
findings.cost: Repeated claims without proof lose to firms that show results.
findings.fix: One claim backed by rankings and results.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp or direct consultation booking appears.
findings.cost: Busy executives leave when the next step is not obvious.
